data.name: Carola
data.gender_notes: Carola is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Kara', meaning 'dear, beloved, free'. In ancient Greece, it was a name for a man, but in the Middle Ages it became popular for women. The name Carola carries the meaning “Free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Carola usually hope their child will grow to embody free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the freedom and courage of the Christian spirit.
data.etymology: Carola belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Carola total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name 'Carol' was popularized in the English-speaking world due to the Christmas carols sung during the Middle Aages.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Carol' carries the meaning of 'song of joy' or 'rejoicing'. It is a reminder of the joy and happiness that comes from the birth of Jesus Christ and the celebration of His life.
